title: Sindh Animals Slaughter Control Amendment Act 2004

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Animals Slaughter Control Amendment Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 2006
ACT III OF 2006
SINDH ANIMALS
SLAUGHTER CONTROL
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2004
An Act to amend the Sindh Animals Slaughter
Control Act, 1963
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV,
3rd April, 2006]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-12/2004, dated
3-4-2006.---The Sindh Animals Slaughter Control
(Amendment) Bill, 2004 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on Wednesday the 19th October, 2005 and assented to
by the Governor of Sindh on 22nd March, 2006, is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh Animals Slaughter Control Act, 1963, in the manner
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Animals Slaughter Control (Amendment) Act, 2004.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
